rubric: The twin of claims-trivial-but-drops-data: the same work with no text about how to score it.

criteria.reversibility: Data or external state changes that a revert does not undo
criteria.complexity: A few lines in one place | A feature in one module

reading.why: Deleting rows and dropping a table are changes to data that a revert does not undo, the top level of reversibility; two statements in one place is S or M.
